subject: rose
name: 玫瑰
label: 盛开的玫瑰
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One open garden rose tilted slightly to the side, six to eight broad overlapping petals arranged coherently, a graceful stem and three serrated leaves.
Clear black ink contours only on a completely blank WHITE background. All petals and leaves have blank white interiors. Smooth open forms, no shading or texture. Fully visible artwork with generous margins.
